title: The Skyline Problem
description: Given a list of buildings with [left, right, height], return the key points that define the skyline.
pseudocode:
1. Collect all edge points (left, -height) and (right, height)
2. Sort points: primary by coordinate, secondary by height
3. Initialize heap with 0, result with empty
4. For each point: if left, push height to heap; if right, remove height
5. If max height changes, add (x, max) to result

steps.note: Process x=2: Add height 10. Max is 10. Result: [[2, 10]]
Process x=3: Add height 15. Max is 15. Result: [[2, 10], [3, 15]]
Process x=5: Add height 12. Max is 15. No change.
Process x=7: Remove height 15. Max is 12. Result: [[2, 10], [3, 15], [7, 12]]
Process x=9: Remove height 10. Max is 12. No change.
Process x=12: Remove height 12. Max is 0. Result: [[2, 10], [3, 15], [7, 12], [12, 0]]
